join.desc: Collaborative Kanban application built with a team. Responsible for the Contacts area: UI, state handling and form logic. Independently diagnosed and fixed a mobile layout bug and a state-persistence bug in the contact detail view, each merged via pull request.

studio.role: Multi-project team & task management · Angular · Supabase · Solo
studio.desc: Dashboard application for managing multiple projects in parallel: Kanban board, team and people management, calendar view, and a live dashboard with per-project status distribution. Data persisted via Supabase, with a custom signal-based store for reactive project, people and task state.
